title: A Well for the House
author: Orsen Thornbury
blurb: Silas Sandoval, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the family out ahead of the count before the well refills.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
